name: Sushi Nights
author: Zalo, Kirblue, Maikel Ortega, Sergio de Prado; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Sushi Nights by Zalo and friends (Game Boy Competition 2021): play as Hitsuji-kun, a hard-boiled sheep who swings through the streets of Neo Sushi City with a grappling hook to deliver sushi to its starving inhabitants. MIT license (github.com/Zal0/SushiNights).

descriptions.en: Sushi Nights by Zalo and friends (Game Boy Competition 2021): play as Hitsuji-kun, a hard-boiled sheep who swings through the streets of Neo Sushi City with a grappling hook to deliver sushi to its starving inhabitants. MIT license (github.com/Zal0/SushiNights).
descriptions.it: Sushi Nights di Zalo e amici (Game Boy Competition 2021): sei Hitsuji-kun, una pecora tutta d'un pezzo che volteggia per le strade di Neo Sushi City con il rampino per consegnare il sushi agli abitanti affamati. Licenza MIT (github.com/Zal0/SushiNights).
